headline: Metso Q3 Orders Surge 28% as Backlog Hits Record High
summary: Industrial equipment maker Metso reported a 28% increase in third-quarter order intake, pushing its total order backlog to a record level.
why: Metso is a major European industrial supplier providing machinery and technology for mining, aggregates, and metals refining.

impacts.name: Metso Oyj
impacts.why: A 28% order jump and record backlog signal durable revenue visibility for heavy equipment makers.
